description: A property of propositional formulas holds for every formula if it holds for each atom and falsum and is preserved by negation and the three binary constructors.
signature:

  {motive : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α → Sort u_1}
  (atom : (a : α) → motive (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.atom a))
  (falsum : motive Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.falsum)
  (neg : (a : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α) → motive a → motive a.neg)
  (conj : (a a_1 : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α) → motive a → motive a_1 → motive (a.conj a_1))
  (disj : (a a_1 : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α) → motive a → motive a_1 → motive (a.disj a_1))
  (impl : (a a_1 : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α) → motive a → motive a_1 → motive (a.impl a_1))
  (t : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α) : motive t
